summary: This sample corner is provisionally a standard layout, and a perpendicular ramp is the likely type if a site check confirms the path width.
findings_narrative: Unreviewed calculations show no surveyed value above the acceptance limits. Some fall outside H-1011's design targets, so a rebuild would need to change them.
engineer_note: Confirm the ramp type, sidewalk width, legal grade and road ownership on site. H-1011 uses the path width to choose the ramp case.
